answer: Registration requires a Wesolowski VDF with a 72-hour sequential delay, so the squaring chain resists parallel speedup. Its output salts a 2 GB Argon2id table, and three random peers verify a sampled slice in minutes. Passing identities enter a haven pool where rewards unlock only after one signed voyage of 20 audited tasks. A 10,000 clone swarm burns 720,000 core-hours, about $36,000 at $0.05, holds 20 TB of RAM for days, and must survive 200,000 audits. Forging that crowd resembles building a dune grain by grain, since the wind depositing each grain cannot be hurried.
